rules lens FAIL -> rework: Dominant strategy (rework): two placements build a deterministic, uncounterable win line. Place a white Gear 23 at mesh-distance 9 straight from the Drive Gear (13 black) down a column — quote: '13 (black) | ... | 9' in the Mesh Table for the 23 column — then a black Gear 13 at mesh-distance 9 further down the same column (row20→row11→row2), landing inside the 'within five holes of your edge' dial-read zone (§5d Re-dock). That final black 13 gives 1.00 'up' per crank, the fastest black rate in the numbers-per-turn table, and it accrues on every crank in the game, not just the owner's — quote: 'Thirty turns of the handle after that — everybody's turns, not just hers.' The Drive Gear 'may mesh several' (§5a), so every seat (N/S/E/W) can build the identical line off its own edge with zero contention, discoverable on a first read, with no Compound Hub ever touched. Sabotage does not deter it: a Pull costs the attacker one token plus a full turn (§5c) while gear_13 (8 copies) and gear_23 (5 copies) sit in open supply (bill), so the owner rebuilds next turn — a losing trade for the attacker. This makes the Compound Hub / Reading Ring subsystem, billed as 'the reason this game cannot be a deck of cards,' strategically optional filler.; idea.json contradiction (clarify): idea.json states 'First dial to 20 wins; a dial driven to -5 jams for one round,' but rules.md sets the win threshold at 30 (§4, §7) and makes a -5 dial lock permanently until the owner spends a full turn on Reset (§5e, §6) — both the win number and the penalty duration changed without the source concept being updated.; idea.json contradiction (clarify): idea.json's stated 'fun_correct_bet' is that direction flips on mesh-chain parity — 'your neighbour's mesh count goes odd' runs a dial backwards — but rules.md replaced that with a fixed rule independent of chain length: 'black climbs, white falls' (§1) and 'Every black gear ... turns clockwise. Every white gear ... turns anticlockwise. Always' (§5a). The parity-based tension the pitch was built on is absent from the shipped mechanic, which is consistent with the dominant straight-line route in the first finding.
